name: Wide Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest to the bar.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A pull-up with a wide grip that emphasises the lats.

safetyNotes: Use assistance if needed; stop with shoulder pain.
